quests.title: Short Delivery, Rooty Hill
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The Rooty Hill order has been two cartons light every week since the long weekend and the invoice says otherwise every time. This is the third time I have had this conversation. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the loading bay round the side
the pallet as it actually arrives
now I have got something to send them

quests.title: The Credit Note, Rooty Hill
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. They admitted it, which I did not expect, so now there is $37 owing to Rooty Hill and it is not going to walk in here itself. It started small, the way these things do. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: $37, and do not take a voucher
cash, on the counter, and I will believe it

quests.title: The Rooty Hill Run
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. I do the Rooty Hill run at half six and there is a stretch of it where the van gets followed, which I have told nobody until now. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: ride it with me as far as Mount Druitt
whatever is behind us when we stop

quests.title: Locked Out, Rooty Hill
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. I have got a milk crate in the back of the van and the Rooty Hill shop is shut, and the number on the door rings out. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: try the flat above the shop
get one in you, this takes a while
somebody has to sign for it

quests.title: The Regulars, Rooty Hill
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Three of the Rooty Hill regulars have started coming in together and going out separately, and the till is $14 down on those days. You will see what I mean the second you get there. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: the ones who come in as a set
$14, which is exactly what the till says

quests.title: The Wholesaler, Rooty Hill
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. Everything Rooty Hill sells comes off a floor at Mount Druitt, and the woman who runs it will tell you things she will not put in writing. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: go and see her before the afternoon
come and tell me what she said about us

quests.title: Under 12s at Lidcombe
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. I have got eleven kids for a twelve-a-side at Lidcombe on school holidays and one of them has a note from his mother. This is the third time I have had this conversation. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the estate behind the ground, ask around
the noticeboard where the sign-on sheet went up
any kid with boots will do at this point

quests.title: Registration, Lidcombe
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. We found a twelfth, which means the Lidcombe club now owes the association $55 it had budgeted on not owing. It started small, the way these things do. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: $55 before the cut-off
I will drive it in myself

quests.title: The Lidcombe Canteen
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The canteen at Lidcombe does two hundred sausages on a Saturday and this week the freezer went off at ten past five. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: we are going to need the coffee
the thermometer, so the insurance believes us

quests.title: Grand Final Float, Lidcombe
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Somebody walked off with the float from the Lidcombe canteen at about ten past five during the last home game, and I have a fair idea which somebody. There is probably a simple explanation and I would love to hear it. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: the pair who were leaning on the roller door
$66, which is what was in the tin

quests.title: Sprinkler Line, Lidcombe
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. The sprinkler line under the Lidcombe outfield has been leaking since school holidays and the wet patch has started to move. You will see what I mean the second you get there. I'll put the kettle on for when you're back.

steps.label: walk the line from the tap to the boundary
where the grass has gone dark
I want to dig once, not five times

quests.title: The Association, Lidcombe
quests.blurb: I have written it down twice and lost it twice. The bloke who allocates grounds for the whole association sits at Auburn, and Lidcombe has been at the bottom of his list for two seasons. There is a version of this where I am the unreasonable one. Just do not come back empty-handed.

steps.label: go and be reasonable at him
tell me if it is us or the paperwork

quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Somebody has been tipping fill into the creek behind Richmond since the week of the show and it is narrowing the channel a metre at a time. This is the third time I have had this conversation. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.

steps.label: the fill, with the water level in shot
the council reads photographs, not letters
